data.content: Porto Romano Industrial Park is another important client for Karrota, as it not only offers larger spaces and more opportunities to grow the potential of any business, but is also a prestigious brand that has entrusted us with refining its logo and managing its social media communication.
The Porto Romano Industrial Park logo consists of sky blue and ash gray colors. This choice reflects the visual combination of these shades as well as the meanings they convey.
Sky blue – represents the endless sea, new opportunities, and sustainability.
Ash gray – symbolizes architecture, balance, and transformation.
We continue our collaboration with this client, focusing on strategic social media communication that directly conveys the brand’s values and unique identity.

Through carefully designed content, our goal is to create an authentic connection with the audience, highlighting the professionalism, innovation, and modern approach of the business, while positioning the client as a trusted and innovative leader in the market.
